answer: Applicants must stake 20 POA for ten epochs, complete four different jobs, and pass two independent reviews by peers who did not fund them. Confirmed copying burns 12% of the stake. Proofs and transfers stay public: an onyx seal marks each signed contribution, a spiral of repeated funding or timing exposes cloned accounts, and the zenith of voting weight arrives only after sustained verified records. Creating many identities multiplies the stake, job trail, and review exposure, so coordinated fraud costs more than honest labour.
